# Verify default-dataset, system-variable and temporary-UDF behavior before expanding support.
# These scripts stand alone; maintainers can collect their answers with just bigquery-answers.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE unverified_procedures.t AS SELECT 3 AS a;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.default_dataset() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT MAX(a) FROM t; END;
SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_procedures';
CALL unverified_procedures.default_dataset()
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.system_dataset() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT @@dataset_id; END;
SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_procedures';
CALL unverified_procedures.system_dataset()
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_procedures;
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION caller_function(x INT64) AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE unverified_procedures.caller_function() OPTIONS(strict_mode=FALSE)
BEGIN SELECT caller_function(1); END;
CALL unverified_procedures.caller_function()
?>
